components.name: Rating Badge
components.description: SwiftUI: RatingBadge(rating:) in WAFishMap/SiteDetailSheet.swift:5. Capsule, rating color at 0.2 with a 1pt rating-color stroke; label always primary ink, never the rating color. nil rating = "No data" (DS.Rating.unrated). VoiceOver: "Rated X" / "No seasonal guidance".

components.name: Closed Badge
components.description: SwiftUI: ClosedBadge in WAFishMap/SiteDetailSheet.swift:46. Label "Closed" with SF Symbol xmark.octagon.fill (circle placeholder here), caption semibold, gray at 0.2 with a 1pt gray stroke.

components.name: Site Marker
components.description: SwiftUI/UIKit: SiteMarkerView in WAFishMap/Map/AnnotationViews.swift:60 (MKMarkerAnnotationView). Balloon tint = rating color, gray when unrated. Glyph white unless white is under 3:1 contrast (Fair yellow gets black). Kind sets the glyph: launch sailboat.fill, shore figure.fishing, pier fish.fill (circle placeholder here). "Season may be closed" = closurePlausible badge, 14x14, +3 trailing / -3 top. Closed site = alpha 0.55. Scale 0.8 of MapKit default; hit area 44pt (MarkerMetrics.minimumTapTarget).

components.name: Site Cluster
components.description: UIKit: SiteClusterView in WAFishMap/Map/AnnotationViews.swift:213 (MKClusterAnnotation). Tint = best (max) rating among members, gray if none rated. Glyph text = member count (DS.TypeScale.clusterCount). Scale 0.95, one step above a pin. Closure badge only if every member at the best rating is closurePlausible.

components.name: Layer Toggle
components.description: SwiftUI: Toggle with LayerToggleStyle(onFill:) in WAFishMap/DesignSystem.swift:217; Rivers and Heat in FishingMapView.swift (~481, ~487). On: white label on the onFill capsule (DS.Chrome.riversOn / heatOn). Off: primary label on tertiarySystemFill. Adds the .isSelected trait when on. Icons: water.waves; flame / flame.fill (circle placeholder here).

components.name: Rating Legend
components.description: SwiftUI: RatingLegend in WAFishMap/FishingMapView.swift:594. 8x8 dots, 3pt dot-to-label, 10pt between entries, labels DS.TypeScale.legend in secondary. Order Prime, Good, Fair, Slow, No data.

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: SwiftUI: GlassCard ViewModifier in WAFishMap/FishingMapView.swift:559 (no inputs). iOS 26+: .glassEffect(.regular, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14)); earlier: .ultraThinMaterial in RoundedRectangle(14). Used by the top plan bar (padding 12/6, 10pt item spacing, 6pt row spacing, max width 560 on regular) and the status bar (max width 460). The blur here approximates Liquid Glass; Figma cannot render the real material.

components.name: Guidance Footer
components.description: SwiftUI: GuidanceFooter(guide:) in WAFishMap/SiteDetailSheet.swift:183. Background DS.Surface.advisory (secondarySystemFill), radius DS.Surface.advisoryRadius (12), padding 12, spacing 8. WDFW link (exclamationmark.shield icon in the app) and disclaimer are optional; the safety line always shows. VoiceOver ids: wdfwLink, guidanceDisclaimer. The disclaimer text here is sample copy; the app reads it from fisheries.json.
